title: Configuration API endpoints to read, validate, and update settings
description: Implement api/settings_router.py with GET /api/settings and PUT /api/settings to inspect and modify sensitivity, closure time thresholds, audio toggle, and UI overlay preferences at runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: PUT /api/settings accepts partial or full updates, validates values against safety limits, and updates live services
Returns 422 with validation errors if parameters fall outside acceptable bounds
Unit tests verify reading, updating, and validation failure responses

steps.details: Create APIRouter(prefix='/api/settings', tags=['settings']) and define SettingsUpdateRequest schema.
Return current settings from SettingsService as JSON.
Validate updated values, apply changes to active StateMachine and AlertManager instances, persist to local settings file, and log settings update event.
Create tests/test_api_settings.py verifying successful updates and validation rejection on invalid thresholds.

technicalNotes: Apply settings updates dynamically without requiring backend server restart.
Validate that closure_seconds > 0.5s to prevent immediate false alarms.
